department: Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Chandigarh Administration

citation.quote: The family annual income of the applicant should not exceed Rs. 1,50,000.
The applicant should be 60 years of age or above.
The applicant should have been residing in Chandigarh UT for more than 3 years.
Only applicants from Chandigarh are eligible.

documents_required: Proof of residence for three years
